name: Lobby welcome (portrait)
description: A calm welcome screen for a reception or lobby: your logo, a headline and a line of detail, with a live clock and date in the building's own timezone and language. Portrait 9:16 layout.
author: ScreenTinker

params.name: logo
params.label: Logo
params.help: A PNG or SVG with a transparent background works best. Shown at the top.

params.name: headline
params.label: Headline
params.default: Good to see you at Northwind Studio

params.name: subline
params.label: Detail line
params.default: Please check in at the front desk — your host will be with you shortly.

params.name: timezone
params.label: Clock timezone
params.help: Leave empty to use the screen's own clock.

params.name: locale
params.label: Language
params.help: The language of the date (weekday and month names), e.g. de or fr-CA. Leave empty for the screen's language.
